title: 9 OCR Checks Before You Send Scanned Text to AI
reader_task: Verify recognized text from scans against the original before an AI model reads it: text presence, page coverage and order, orientation, small print, numbers, dates and identifiers, reading order, tables and a final side-by-side pass.
scope_exclusions: Not a PDF token-cost article (E06) or format comparison (E07)
Rotation experiments in depth belong to M02-S1
Field-by-field number verification procedure belongs to M02-S2
Mixed-PDF coverage audit belongs to M02-S3
No accuracy rates or recognition guarantees
description: Nine OCR quality checks for AI: confirm pages, order, numbers, IDs, tables and reading order against the original before a model reads your scanned text.
description_change: Rewritten from the registry proposal to name the checks; contains the primary keyword; 160 characters.
excerpt: Recognized text can read smoothly and still be wrong. In our test, a clean scan lost a whole table column and turned a letter O into a zero.
author: DevBehindYou
